question: Which element is essential for the synthesis of thyroxine?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Iodine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Iodine **is a **necessary **and **limiting substrate **for the **thyroid gland**.
 
• It **helps **in the **synthesis of thyroxine**.
 
• The **deficiency of Iodine **can cause **hypothyroidism**, **developmental brain disorders**, and **goiter**.
 
• **Thyroxine **is the **main hormone secreted **(into the bloodstream) by the **thyroid gland**. 
 
• **The thyroid gland **produces **two types **of hormones namely**, T3 and T4 **(Thyroxine)
 
• **Iodine **is an **essential element **for the **synthesis of the hormone, thyroxine**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manganese activates **specific **enzymes **such as **pyruvate carboxylase, lipase, and superoxide dismutase.**
 
• Z**inc **for the **synthesis of tryptophan**, **a key amino acid **in the **synthesis **of the **auxin indoleacetic acid.**
 
• **Iron** is **an essential micronutrient for plants**. It is required for the **synthesis of chlorophyll **and has several other functions also
